All three voters agree on SINGLE_SOURCE_OK / different_formulation, and my reading of p.118 and the Lean confirms it. Lemma 10.2 has no standalone unconditional declaration, but selected_witness exports hz and ea/eb/ep, so boundaryLimits_locallyUniform applies in one step to the actual periodized residual; smoothness, compatibility, origin flatness and the R³ compact-support form follow from the smooth forcing with jets equal to boundaryLimits and from compactForce. findings.summary: No single declaration states Lemma 10.2 unconditionally. The limit theorem is conditional on hz/eA/ev/ep; selected_witness exports exactly those hypotheses (via SelectedSchedule and ea/eb/ep) alongside a merged 10.2+10.3 forcing statement.

Lean's f is the residual of the cut, lattice-periodized fields, not the compactly supported R³ residual. Convergence is locally uniform, and the limit tensors are periodic with no 'supported in K' clause.

Proof route: the paper derives the limits from Theorem 3.1(ii) bounds plus FTC, exterior heat formulas, and flatness (10.9). Lean takes VanishingJointJets at (1,0) and smooth one-sided extensions at every x ≠ 0 as the intermediate facts.
boundaryLimits_zero, cited as the counterpart of ∂^αF_j(0)=0, is true by definition: the limit object is defined to be 0 at x = 0. The substantive flatness is the convergence to it at the origin.
